ErpSectionDoc.title: ErpSectionDoc
ErpSectionDoc.description: Stores a synchronized ERP module collection payload and metadata in Firestore for cross-device persistence.

orgKey.description: Organization identifier key for access validation.

sectionId.description: The identifier of the ERP section (e.g. invoices, customers, deliverySlips, products, settings).

payloadJson.description: Serialized state for the ERP module section.

updatedBy.description: Username of the operator who performed the update.

AuthAccountDoc.title: AuthAccountDoc
AuthAccountDoc.description: Stores login credentials (username, PIN, recovery info, and optional biometric passkey metadata) for the ERP login page.

orgKey.description: Organization identifier key for access validation.

fingerprintEnabled.description: Whether fingerprint login is enabled for this account.

credentialId.description: Optional WebAuthn credential ID encoded in base64url.

updatedAtIso.description: ISO timestamp of last credential update.

ConnectionTestDoc.title: ConnectionTestDoc
ConnectionTestDoc.description: Diagnostic document used to verify Firestore connectivity on startup.

/erp_sections/{sectionId}.description: Stores real-time synchronized ERP data modules (invoices, customers, deliverySlips, products, payments, settings, etc.).

/erp_auth_accounts/{accountId}.description: Stores ERP user login credentials (username, PIN, forgot-PIN reset, and fingerprint registration).

/test/{testId}.description: Used by getDocFromServer on boot to verify online connectivity to Firestore.
